text:
jake_ae: FYI - AuroraPayments wants a colo HSM POC. They require threshold signing (2-of-3 custodians), immutable audit trail, and rotation every 14 days. Asking for staging cutover next Tue. Need quick feasibility + price delta. cc @ashish_se @carol_security @tom_infra

ashish_se: Threshold signing adds complexity. Are they doing key-splitting inside their HSM cluster or across multiple HSMs? Also interface preference: PKCS#11 with vendor-specific modules or KMIP? Network model matters (direct peering vs proxy).

jake_ae: They said split across three different HSM appliances in their colo (non-cloud). PKCS#11 + vendor module. Latency constraint: signing tails must be <200ms median. Peak sustained 400 rps.

carol_security: 2-of-3 custodians is ok. We'll need: attestation (HSM model + FIPS cert), custodian onboarding checklist, runbook for split-key operations, and signed rotation proofs. Pen-test addendum required for colo access. Blocker: our default BYOK proxy assumes single endpoint; need multi-endpoint coordination and deterministic failover.

ashish_se: Implementation options: (A) Proxy orchestrates by sending signing request to all three HSMs and reconstructs signature, (B) Use client-side threshold library and HSMs hold key shares and perform partial sign. Option B preferred for latency, but needs vendor support. We should request vendor modules and test vectors.

jake_ae: Procurement question: how to price? They want no per-sign surcharge if possible. Prefer predictable monthly fee.

tom_infra: For strict SLA and their peak, recommend reserved capacity nodes + network egress plan. Pricing model: base onboarding + monthly reserved throughput tier (covers up to X rps), overage per-1M ops. Can offer POC discount: small flat POC fee that covers runbook + attestation + 2 dry-run windows.

jake_ae: Can we do a POC where we only validate latency and rotation proof (manual rotation allowed) and skip automated rotation until production?

carol_security: Manual rotation OK for POC as long as we capture signed rotation artifacts and tamper-evident logs. We'll need a sample audit entry and an example signed rotation proof they will accept. Example log snippet:```
2026-05-02T15:12:01Z INFO rotation executed rotation_id=aurora-rot-20260502 method=manual custodians=[alice,bob,carol] proof_sig=sha256:123abc
```

ashish_se: For PKCS#11 we need their vendor .so and a test HSM account. Also need ssh/VPN jumpbox details for the colo network path. We'll provide a lightweight staging proxy. Sample curl to hit proxy (returns partial signatures):```
curl -X POST https://staging-proxy.redwood.local/sign \ 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer poctoken" \ 
  -d '{"key_id":"aurora-1","payload":"..."}'
```

infra_bot: staging-proxy deployed to staging-az1 at 2026-05-02T04:03Z. VPN config awaiting customer IP allowlist.

jake_ae: Customer legal insists no key escrow and no plaintext key material leaving their devices. Also require proof-of-rotation chain and notarized attestation for production. Is notarization a blocker?

carol_security: Notarized attestation is doable via our 3rd-party auditor add-on (extra cost). For POC we can provide internal attestation + logs; production will need external.

ashish_se: Next steps: 1) request vendor PKCS#11 module + test account, 2) customer IP ranges and VPN creds, 3) confirmation on whether partial-sign aggregation happens client-side or via our proxy. If they prefer client-side threshold lib, we need to validate compatibility.

jake_ae: I'll ask Aurora for the three HSM models, vendor contact, and allowlist. Also confirm they accept manual rotation proof for POC.

tom_infra: I'll draft SOW: small POC fee, two dry-runs, optional auditor add-on line item, reserved capacity tier for production. Share draft by EOD.

carol_security: I'll draft security Q&A and required artifacts list (attestation, runbook, logs example).

jake_ae: Thanks team. Will update after vendor artifacts land. :thumbsup:
